governing_principles: Y is not identical to B_x, D_rel, or R.
Y may restrict or index a context relation but cannot create one from unrelated types.
Context relation hypotheses are evaluated without source or observation threshold outcomes.
Definite non-relation requires complete applicable context-rule evidence.
Undefined context evidence is not coerced to mismatch.

hypotheses.orientation_bearing_surface: A boundary-interaction aspect extracted from Y under the declared context scope.
hypotheses.positive_condition: A governed extractor returns a boundary aspect b_y and a typed relation relates it to B_x.
hypotheses.negative_condition: Complete applicable boundary-rule evidence returns no boundary aspect or definitively rejects the relation; this is local to boundary mediation.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: Y type, boundary extractor, target applicability, authority, provenance, or dependency stage is unresolved.
hypotheses.falsification_case: A governed Y context has no extractable boundary-interaction aspect and no applicable authorized boundary relation.
hypotheses.threshold_independence: No D(X|Z), d_obs, epsilon_src, or epsilon_obs evaluation is used.

hypotheses.orientation_bearing_surface: A relational-domain aspect extracted from Y that constrains applicability without being identical to D_rel.
hypotheses.positive_condition: A governed extractor returns d_y and a typed domain relation establishes applicability to D_rel.
hypotheses.negative_condition: Complete applicable domain-rule evidence returns no domain aspect or definitively rejects the relation; this is local to domain mediation.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: Y type, domain extractor, target type, authority, provenance, or dependency stage is unresolved.
hypotheses.falsification_case: A governed Y context has no domain-bearing aspect and no applicable authorized domain relation.
hypotheses.threshold_independence: Domain applicability is evaluated without either distinction-floor outcome.

hypotheses.orientation_bearing_surface: A residue-relevant aspect or history reference carried by Y without identifying Y with residue R.
hypotheses.positive_condition: A governed extractor returns r_y and a typed residue relation establishes the relevant context linkage.
hypotheses.negative_condition: Complete applicable residue-rule evidence returns no residue aspect or definitively rejects the relation; this is local to residue mediation.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: Y history/type, residue extractor, target applicability, authority, provenance, or dependency stage is unresolved.
hypotheses.falsification_case: A governed Y context has no residue-relevant aspect and no applicable authorized residue relation.
hypotheses.threshold_independence: Residue mediation is evaluated without source or observation threshold outcomes.

hypotheses.orientation_bearing_surface: No applicable boundary, domain, or residue aspect exists under complete context-rule analysis.
hypotheses.relation_definition_candidate: CompleteApplicableContextRuleSets_x(Y) AND NoApplicableContextRelation_x(Y, B_x, D_rel, R)
hypotheses.positive_condition: Not applicable; definite non-relation requires complete rule-set evidence.
hypotheses.negative_condition: Complete governed context rule sets establish no applicable relation for the stated target component.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: Any component rule set, authority, provenance, applicability, or dependency completeness evidence is absent.
hypotheses.falsification_case: An authorized applicable component relation is found for any target.
hypotheses.threshold_independence: Global context non-relation is determined without threshold evaluation.

hypotheses.orientation_bearing_surface: The current Y declaration does not determine which context-bearing aspects, if any, are available.
hypotheses.relation_definition_candidate: ContextRelation_x(Y, target) = UNDEFINED when required type, aspect, rule, authority, provenance, or dependency evidence is unresolved.
hypotheses.positive_condition: Not applicable while context evidence is unresolved.
hypotheses.negative_condition: Not applicable; undefined context is not coerced to mismatch.
hypotheses.undefined_condition: Any component mapping, source/target type, authority, provenance, or dependency completeness evidence is missing.
hypotheses.falsification_case: Complete governed context evidence resolves the relation as represented or not represented.
hypotheses.threshold_independence: Undefined context status is assigned before threshold evaluation.
